propositions.proposition_text: An occupier of a holding must not spread organic manure within 10 metres of surface water.
propositions.subject: An occupier of a holding
propositions.rule: must not spread organic manure within 10 metres of surface water
propositions.evidence_text: An occupier of a holding must not spread organic manure within 10 metres of surface water.

propositions.proposition_text: An occupier of a holding must measure the distance from the edge of the surface water before spreading organic manure.
propositions.subject: An occupier of a holding
propositions.rule: must measure the distance from the edge of the surface water before spreading organic manure
propositions.evidence_text: The distance is measured from the edge of the surface water.
propositions.reason: Independent measurement obligation sharing the distance concept with the prohibition; must not be collapsed as a dependent qualification.
